thread:
alice: Quick FYI — discovered partner webhook secret in staging logs. It looks like a KMS-wrapped blob from last month leaked into our ingestion logs. Need a coordinated scrub + rotation and RBAC hardening. I started a quick rotate for staging but want Prod plan before we touch anything there.
ben: Ack. Can you paste the path and sample log lines (redacted)?
alice: Path: /var/log/ingest/staging/partner-processor.log
Example: "received payload id=xyz meta=kms:ciphertext:projects/project/locations/global/keyRings/r1/cryptoKeys/k1:ENCRYPTED..." (redacted blob)
carol: Thanks. First tasks: 1) Freeze partner ingestion in staging 2) Rotate any exposed SA keys 3) Enable/verify Vault audit logs for the namespace 4) Schedule Prod rotation window.
chris: I can freeze ingestion — will flip the flag on the ingestion service now. :white_check_mark:
sec-oncall-bot: action_taken: service.ingest.staging.toggle -> OFF by chris at 1746009955
ben: For rotation: propose we rewrap the ciphertexts with a new cryptoKey and rotate the service account keys used to sign requests. Staging first, then Prod in a maintenance window.
alice: Agreed. Carol, can you lead RBAC review? We should prune old roles that allow partner SA impersonation.
carol: On it. Running a quick query to list principals with iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on partner SAs.
carol: Query result (summary): 4 principals (infra-batch, deployer, ci-runner, legacy-migration). I'll prepare a PR to narrow scopes and add 1h emergency rollback plan.
ben: Rotation commands for reference: 
```bash
# rewrap ciphertext
gcloud kms keys versions add-rotation-schedule --key=projects/.../cryptoKeys/k1 --location=global
gcloud kms keys versions encrypt --key=... --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=new.ct
# rewrap with new key
```
alice: Also: enable Vault audit logging if not present: 
```bash
vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log
# or if using syslog
vault audit enable syslog tag=vault
```
chris: I'll tail the staging logs while the rewrap runs and watch for any exposures.
sec-oncall-bot: notify: #support-partner-ingest at 1746010100 (scheduled msg)
alice: Partner PM notified via email, asked them to pause pushes from their side until we clear.
ben: One more: we should sweep CI artifacts for embedded ciphertexts. I can run a scanning script across artifact registry and S3 buckets.
carol: RBAC PR drafted here: https://git.internal/r/rb/pr/891 (cc @alice @ben) — includes temporary deny-list for legacy-migration.
alice: Good. Let's also issue short-lived tokens for services that need immediate access instead of long-lived keys. Use workload identity where possible.
ben: ETA for staging full scrub + rotate: ~2.5 hours. Will post updates in this thread.
chris: Staging ingestion is paused; waiting for ben to kick off rotate.
ben: starting rotation run now (staging). Will post logs.
ben: rotation finished for staging: rewrap done, SA keys rotated, Vault audit confirmed. No other ciphertexts found in staging artifacts after sweep.
alice: Great. Can you add the audit log archive to secure GCS and set retention?
ben: Done — archive bucket: gs://redwood-secure-archives/vault-audit/ and retention set to 365d.
carol: RBAC PR merged and rollout initiated. Noted rollback steps in PR description.
alice: Next: schedule Prod maintenance window for tomorrow 0200-0400 UTC. I'll loop in infra oncall and partner ops.
sec-oncall-bot: maintenance_event_created id=me-1746010500 window=2024-02-21T02:00:00Z-2024-02-21T04:00:00Z
alice: Thanks all. Closing action items: ben -> prod rotation runbook, carol -> RBAC post-checklist, chris -> monitoring dashboard alert for ciphertext exposures, me -> partner sign-off. Update this thread when done.
ben: will update here after prod run.
chris: set dashboard alert: AlertID=A-8732, firing threshold=3 matches /hr
alice: Closing note: no evidence of exfil beyond staging logs so far. Good containment. :locked_with_key:
ben: prod rotation kicked off at 1746010800. Monitoring looks clean so far.
alice: Thanks team. Follow-up retro in #postmortems tomorrow.
